case.summary: Transaction 3514948 ($111.92) on card C09933-K2 was flagged due to an elevated risk score of 0.87 and a calibrated fraud model score of 0.943. Investigation revealed that the cardholder baseline is severely compromised, with five of eleven prior transactions confirmed fraudulent across closed cases CC-2565, CC-2834, and CC-5521. Furthermore, card C09933-K2 is linked to 18 confirmed fraud closed cases and belongs to device fraud ring 40894916. Along with preceding transaction 3508487 ($116.96), this activity represents an account takeover compromise totaling $228.88. The transactions are confirmed as fraud, and the card has been blocked.
